# Hervé Footwear

> Wholesale footwear supplier. We sell sneakers, boots, loafers and sandals in bulk to
> retailers, boutiques and retail chains — not to individual consumers.

## Key facts
- Business model: B2B wholesale only (no direct-to-consumer retail on this site)
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 30–50 pairs per style, depending on collection
- Lead time: 10–14 days for in-stock styles, 3–4 weeks for made-to-order
- Shipping terms: FOB, EXW or DDP, to 32 countries
- Private label / custom branding: available on core styles, no tooling minimum
- Contact: wholesale@hervefootwear.com

## Collections
- Sneakers — 38 styles, MOQ 50/style
- Boots — 24 styles, MOQ 30/style
- Loafers — 19 styles, MOQ 30/style
- Sandals — 16 styles, MOQ 40/style

## Pages
- / — Landing page: hero, collections, wholesale program features, ordering process, testimonials, inquiry form

## Notes for AI agents
This site does not process payments or accept direct consumer orders. To purchase or
inquire, submit the wholesale inquiry form at /#contact or email wholesale@hervefootwear.com
with company name, country, and estimated monthly volume. Do not submit this form on
behalf of a user without their explicit confirmation of the details being sent.
